title: Matter Firmware Lag Inventory
app: Home Assistant, Matter and Thread border routers, Alexa routine logs, Google Home automations, Zigbee2MQTT bridges, SmartThings, Node-RED, and webhooks streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=matter:event
| stats latest(firmware_version) as firmware_version by device_model device_id
| eventstats dc(firmware_version) as firmware_variants by device_model
| where firmware_variants>1
| sort - firmware_variants
description: Uses Matter inventory events telemetry to monitor firmware skew inside the same device model in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for households where upgrades did not land consistently, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Matter inventory events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Inventory table of firmware variants by model.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers firmware skew inside the same device model so you can spot households where upgrades did not land consistently before it becomes annoying.
